現金及約當現金淨變動

definition.zh-TW: 三大活動現金流量的合計，也就是這段期間現金總共增加或減少了多少。它必須等於帳上現金的實際變動。
definition.en: The three activity totals added together: how much cash rose or fell over the period. It must equal the actual movement in the cash account.
